Radio carries a long century-old lead, a crowd of tall vintage radio sets or a long track behind it, and podcasts catch it and pass it by one point, 40 vs 39. Data drives the podcast side past the radio at the moment of the overtake. The one accent goes on podcasts, and the 35%/65% split does not appear.
